LanguageData.Gun_L85A1_RWP.description: The L85A1 is an automatic rifle known for its bullpup design, providing a compact form with a full-length barrel. It offers a moderate rate of fire and good accuracy, making it effective for medium-range combat. However, its maintenance can be demanding and reliability issues may arise under harsh conditions. Ideal for colonists who need a balance of firepower and precision.
